summary_rationale: On a strictly price-blind fundamental audit as of November 20, 2026, Donnelley Financial Solutions (DFIN) retains a CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL business quality verdict, with operational KPI health updated to PASS_WITH_WATCH. Since its October 2016 spin-off from R.R. Donnelley, DFIN has transformed from a legacy financial printer into a cash-generative compliance software and services provider: Software Solutions reached 51.5% of Q3 2026 net sales ($95.2M of $185.0M) and $286.3M (+7.0% YoY) in 9M 2026, anchored by ActiveDisclosure (+24% YoY in Q3 2026, >$100M TTM). Consolidated TTM Adjusted EBITDA rose to $253.1M (32.2% margin), 9M 2026 free cash flow jumped to $131.0M ($167.3M CFO less $36.3M CapEx), and net debt fell to $99.8M (0.4x TTM Adjusted EBITDA; $127.0M total debt vs. $27.2M cash) with 18.25% ROIC. Watch flags explain why KPI health shifts to PASS_WITH_WATCH: (1) IC-SS (Arc Suite) stalled at -1.9% YoY in Q3 2026 ($31.1M) and 0.0% organic in 9M 2026 post-TSR; (2) CM-SS Segment Adjusted EBITDA dropped -6.8% YoY in Q3 2026 (-490 bps to 30.0% margin) on +22.4% SG&A and higher bad-debt expense; (3) the SEC 2026 deregulatory agenda (proposed Form N-PORT rollback and e-delivery default project) threatens legacy Print & Distribution ($109.4M TTM) and fund compliance fees; (4) Workiva ($1.041B-$1.044B FY2026 revenue guidance, $167.7M 9M R&D) and AI-enabled VDR rivals (SS&C Intralinks, Datasite) raise competitive R&D demands; (5) balance-sheet footnotes carry $405.5M goodwill (51.4% of assets) and $23.3M residual frozen pension/OPEB liabilities; and (6) May 2026 GCM leadership departure plus 201,650 shares of November 2026 executive sales alongside rising TTM SBC ($34.3M) warrant governance scrutiny.
